name: Alt-Lite
summary: A loose, mostly online and American right-wing current that emerged around 2016-2017 and defines itself against both mainstream conservatism and the white-nationalist alt-right. It combines Trump-aligned populism, cultural or civic nationalism, opposition to illegal immigration and often to Islam, hostility to feminism and political correctness, and a free-speech and anti-establishment stance. Its adherents deny ethnic or racial hierarchy, though critics dispute how sincere that is.
scope: The 2016-2018 'alt-lite' or 'new right' milieu named by the ADL: figures such as Milo Yiannopoulos, Mike Cernovich, Gavin McInnes (Proud Boys founder) and Paul Joseph Watson, using the Breitbart 2016 guide and their documented statements. It excludes the white-nationalist alt-right, mainstream conservatism and later violent Proud Boys splinters. There is no program, so most economic and institutional answers are low-confidence inferences, and members differ widely (libertarian vs economic-nationalist).

universal-healthcare.rationale: Cernovich floated single-payer while others in the milieu are market-minded; no shared line, so split.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Not a concern of the movement; Republican-aligned adherents generally oppose higher taxes on the wealthy.

unions-good.rationale: Anti-left and pro-business Trumpism; no documented union support, so a weak inference.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Anti-big-tech censorship complaints coexist with deregulatory Trumpism; adherents are split.

cut-welfare.rationale: Wikipedia notes alt-lite members criticise welfare spending.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Anti-establishment free-speech rhetoric and security-minded nationalism pull opposite ways.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Libertarian-leaning members favour it, while McInnes's Proud Boys tenets are anti-drug; genuinely split.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Opposing speech limits and political correctness is a defining theme; free-speech rallies were a hallmark.

state-harmful.rationale: Minimal-government rhetoric exists but nationalists want a strong state for borders; most reject abolition.

limit-guns.rationale: Gun rights are listed among Proud Boys tenets by press accounts and are standard for the Trump-aligned right.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Libertarian-minded provocateurs may agree while socially conservative members disagree; split.

decide-locally.rationale: No documented stance; nationalists favour a strong national government but libertarians favour localism.

traditional-family.rationale: McInnes's group venerates the housewife and opposes feminism, stressing traditional gender and family roles.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Split: Yiannopoulos opposed it in Australia, while gay figures within the milieu and many members accept it.

more-religion-public.rationale: Cultural-Christian defence of the West against Islam, but many members are secular provocateurs; split.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The Proud Boys refuse to apologise for Western civilisation and oppose racial guilt; the milieu rejects identity-based remedies.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Anti-feminist and anti-LGBT-rights movement rejecting social-justice gender theory.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Cultural nationalism is the defining alt-lite position, set against alt-right ethnic nationalism.

gradual-change.rationale: Anti-establishment disrupters, but not revolutionary; leaning against respect for established institutions.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Opposes illegal immigration and many oppose Muslim immigration; less than the alt-right's call for sharp cuts overall.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Nationalist, anti-globalist Trump-aligned milieu rejects supranational authority.

free-trade.rationale: Cernovich calls himself an economic nationalist; Trump-aligned trade scepticism is common.

nation-first.rationale: Nationalism and Trump's America First are core to the movement.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: The alt-lite is generally non-interventionist; Cernovich criticised the Syria strikes.

open-borders.rationale: Closed borders is a stated Proud Boys tenet and opposition to illegal immigration is central.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Trump-aligned right opposes drastic climate regulation; not a central theme.

experts-over-public.rationale: Hostile to media, academia and establishment expertise; populist anti-elite stance.

central-planning.rationale: Strongly anti-left and anti-socialist; central planning is opposed.

basic-income.rationale: Cernovich has backed some form of basic income while others oppose welfare; split.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Economic-nationalist Trump-aligned stance, as Cernovich describes himself.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Anti-communist and capitalist-leaning; abolition of wages rejected.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Libertarian members may agree, but no shared stance; split.

one-party-rule.rationale: Movement celebrates free speech and Trump-era elections; one-party rule is rejected.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Neoreactionary monarchism belongs to the alt-right intellectuals, not this wing; split.

democracy-best.rationale: Civic nationalists work within electoral politics and support Trump, unlike alt-right critics of democracy.

direct-votes.rationale: Populist leanings but no documented support for referendums.

workers-councils.rationale: Left-socialist form of rule the anti-left movement rejects.

natural-rulers.rationale: Alt-lite distances itself from the alt-right's hierarchical, anti-egalitarian intellectuals.

political-violence-never.rationale: Proud Boys treat violence against antifa as a core tenet and some figures joke about it, though others deny it.

separate-church-state.rationale: Mixed secular provocateurs and cultural Christians; split.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Cultural defence of the West is not theocratic; many members secular.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Not a movement theme; nationalists want a strong state.

military-superiority.rationale: America First nationalism favours a strong military, though non-interventionist.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Alt-lite explicitly rejects the alt-right's ethnic nationalism for civic or cultural nationalism.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Marxist concept opposed by the anti-left movement.

equal-outcomes.rationale: The Breitbart guide praises 'natural conservatives' who prefer hierarchy and order over radical egalitarianism, and Wikipedia says many in the alt-lite oppose welfare.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Refuses to apologise for the West's creation of the modern world.

civilizational-union.rationale: Civilisational Western identity appeals, but nationalism and America First cut against political union.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Cultural libertarian strand; no explicit statement.

human-enhancement.rationale: Libertarian leanings versus traditionalism; Cernovich is self-improvement oriented but no policy line.

restore-past-order.rationale: Cultural nostalgia present but provocateurs also want disruption; split.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Cernovich says the new right is not bound to conservatism; weak signal.

direct-action.rationale: Rallies and street fights alongside electoral work for Trump; split.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Left-radical idea opposed by the movement.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Marxist claim rejected by the anti-left movement.

taxation-theft.rationale: Libertarian-leaning members agree; nationalist conservatives do not.

harm-principle.rationale: Cultural libertarians accept it but social conservatives do not.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Breitbart authors call themselves cultural libertarians and oppose group identity politics.

state-as-business.rationale: Trump business-style governance appeals, but not a stated idea.

positive-liberty.rationale: Welfare-sceptical stance rejects material-means conception of freedom.

media-academia-power.rationale: Claims that media, academia and the establishment police speech is a central theme of the Breitbart guide.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Breitbart guide endorses human biodiversity as a legitimate debate, but alt-lite officially disavows racial hierarchy; split.

national-rebirth.rationale: Trumpist Make America Great Again narrative of decline and renewal.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Rejects postmodern social-justice epistemology and defends Western reason.

national-self-determination.rationale: Civic nationalism endorses each nation governing itself.

force-without-un.rationale: Non-interventionist and nationalist rejection of UN authority pull in opposite directions.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Secular provocateurs and religious members split.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Welfare-critical and anti-illegal-immigration; benefits for citizens only follows.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Defends Western heritage rather than discarding it.

dominated-front.rationale: Western chauvinism opposes such anti-Western fronts.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Proud Boys venerate the housewife but law-based roles are not advocated; split.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Cultural nationalism requires immigrants to adopt national culture.

elite-replacement.rationale: Great Replacement ideas circulate in parts of the milieu while the alt-lite mainstream disavows them; split.

national-mission.rationale: Non-interventionist, yet Western chauvinism asserts superiority; split.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Anti-feminist; Yiannopoulos calls feminism man-hating and disputes the pay gap.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about elites being out of touch or general anti-establishment feeling, not about elites putting their own interests first, which this statement now asks.

reviewHistory.rationale: The Breitbart guide says natural conservatives were abandoned by both sides of the political establishment, and Milo vowed to dedicate his life to 'the destruction of the Republican Party'.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Eugenic policy is an alt-right fringe theme not adopted.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Libertarian-leaning members agree, nationalists want more state.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Rejects white-identity politics; Cernovich said he did not realise alt-right was ethno-nationalist.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Civic nationalists distance from racial hierarchy, though critics dispute sincerity.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Opposes guilt narratives about Western settlement.

trade-surplus.rationale: Economic nationalist outlook favours a trade surplus.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Proud Boys say they do not start fights but treat violence as a tenet; not absolutist.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Western chauvinism celebrates competitive modern West; weak inference.

party-controls-media.rationale: The Breitbart guide urges 'free speech in the face of the regressive Left's censorship sprees', and Milo says his real concerns are 'pop culture and free speech'.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Non-interventionist currents agree; Trump-aligned conservatives mostly keep alliances.

people-in-arms.rationale: Gun-rights supporters but not militia-abolition of armies.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Divided-nation reunification is not relevant to an American-centred movement.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Hostile to academia and elite media; populist theme.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The ADL reports that McInnes founded the Proud Boys as 'Western chauvinists who refuse to apologise for creating the modern world', the members' oath.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Secular-leaning provocateurs; many members reject it.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Libertarian and free-speech leaning provocateurs oppose it.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Civic nationalism rejects ethnic descent as the basis.

collective-defense.rationale: Non-interventionist doubts versus nationalist military pride; split.

leader-cult.rationale: Trump devotion is strong, but formal leader worship is not advocated.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Rejects ethnic nationalism and supranational union.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Economic nationalism is trade-sceptical but not autarkic; colonies irrelevant.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about a civilization, a region or Eurocentrism rather than the student's own nation, which is all the statement now asks about.

reviewHistory.rationale: Western chauvinism wants Western civilisation taught without apology.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Western superiority view but non-interventionist; split.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Opposes racial guilt and preferences; core anti-identity-politics view.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Libertarian members agree, civic nationalists want to be seen as non-racist; split.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Gun rights and free speech defended constitutionally.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Members split between libertarian self-reliance and nationalist populism, and no line is documented.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Members are split and no line is documented in the sources.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Anti-feminism and attention to men's issues are core to the current, per the cited sources on Yiannopoulos, Cernovich and McInnes.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Libertarian-minded members might agree while law-and-order members would not; no documented line.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Free-speech and anti-establishment stance favours transparency, but no documented position.

religious-nation.rationale: Defines itself as civic or cultural nationalist rather than religious; positions on Islam are cultural, not a religious definition of the nation.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: The milieu has no programme on interregional finance; libertarian and nationalist strands split on subsidies between regions.

religion-illusion.rationale: The milieu defends Western civilisation and Christianity as heritage, though Yiannopoulos and others are personally mixed; the material-conditions theory is not theirs.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Anti-feminism is a recurring theme, with feminism seen as harmful, and the milieu rejects structural economic explanations of gender inequality.

treaties-binding.rationale: The milieu has no documented position on treaties with internal nations; sovereignty-minded and rule-of-law instincts pull in different directions.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Hostility to feminism and political correctness is central, and it rejects identity-based oppression frameworks.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Opposition to Islam is a defining theme, with Yiannopoulos and McInnes attacking Islam and Muslim immigration.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Anti-feminism is a recurring theme and the milieu mocks ecological and feminist theory; Yiannopoulos and the Proud Boys reject feminism, so a link is firmly rejected.

racial-franchise.rationale: The alt-lite defines itself against the alt-right's racial nationalism and denies ethnic hierarchy, per the ADL and Cernovich and Watson on nationalism without white identity politics.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: The milieu is hostile to the left and to political correctness and defends Western tradition and free expression, and does not support state-imposed unbelief.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Some members, such as the tech-adjacent ones, might care, but it is not a theme of the current and nothing documented supports a view.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Hostility to what it calls political correctness and to apology politics is balanced by no stated position on genocide recognition; left neutral.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The Proud Boys and others celebrate self-defence and the use of force against opponents, and reject pacifism as weakness.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Adherents stress civic Western values rather than ethnic ancient continuity, and explicitly separate themselves from racial nationalism.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: The milieu is hostile to gender ideology and Yiannopoulos and others stress biological sex differences.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: The style is irreverent and ironic, though it frames a culture war; a literal spiritual struggle is not part of its self-description.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Adherents deny any ethnic or racial hierarchy and define nationalism as civic, so an ethnic claim on the economy is rejected, though critics dispute their sincerity.

independent-unions.rationale: Anti-establishment but not focused on labour; libertarian and economic-nationalist strands differ.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Libertarian members oppose public provision while economic nationalists accept it; split and undiscussed.

family-wage.rationale: Economic questions are split between libertarians and economic nationalists.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Deregulatory, pro-business strand favours faster approval; not directly documented.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Libertarian members favour it and nationalists are indifferent; split.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Nationalists favour central power while libertarians favour devolution; undiscussed.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The milieu is defined by nationalism without white identity politics and rejects organising by racial group.

racial-pride.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about pride in ancestry, culture or nation with reservations about race, and the statement now asks only about pride in one's race.

reviewHistory.rationale: Proud Boys 'Western chauvinism' refuses apology for Western heritage, though it is cultural rather than racial.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Cernovich's interventionism and the milieu's Trump-era hawkishness are mixed with non-interventionist voices.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Alt-lite stresses civic, cultural nationalism tied to state and Western culture rather than a language-defined nation across borders.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Anti-establishment and libertarian-leaning members dislike unions, while economic nationalists are mixed; there is no documented line.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Libertarian members oppose such subsidies while economic nationalists around Trump accept them; the milieu has no shared view.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Market-minded members favour fiscal restraint but Trump-aligned populists do not, so adherents split.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Economic nationalists such as Cernovich want trade rules that favour the United States, not developing countries.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Members who call themselves cultural libertarians welcome pluralism, while economic nationalists want a national economic line; no common position.

sacred-nation.rationale: Nulled: the rationale says alt-lite civic or cultural nationalism stops short of treating the nation as sacred, which does not support agreeing with this statement (Codex review, 2026-11-10); its sources need re-reading.

reviewHistory.rationale: It stands for cultural or civic nationalism, but its civic framing stops short of treating the nation as sacred.

voter-id.rationale: Claims of voter fraud and demands for voter ID are staples of the Trump-aligned right that the alt-lite belongs to.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Adherents mostly oppose Islam while defending Western Christian civilisation but also champion secular free speech; no shared line on legal precedence.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: The milieu celebrates electoral victories such as Trump's yet distrusts the establishment and its institutions, and the sources show no stated view; split.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: The alt-lite sees itself as a free-speech, anti-censorship movement and objects to platform bans, so government shutdowns would be opposed, though order-minded members may differ.

women-suffrage.rationale: The alt-lite attacks feminism but does not campaign against women voting, unlike the white-nationalist alt-right.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Hostility to feminism is central to the milieu, so dedicated state gender-equality bodies would be opposed.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Split between libertarian-leaning members who accept such property claims and economic nationalists who do not; no shared line in the sources.

national-church-status.rationale: Split: Western chauvinism sometimes includes Christian heritage, but the milieu has no common position on state churches.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: No shared line in the sources; members differ and the issue is not central to the milieu.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: The milieu denies racial hierarchy and attacks identity-based grievance politics as political correctness.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Economic nationalists in the milieu worry about jobs while others are market-minded; no shared line.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Cernovich-style economic nationalism joins national loyalty with working-class appeal, though libertarians in the milieu disagree.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Wikipedia notes alt-lite members criticise welfare spending. (Carried over from cut-welfare, "Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

missingStatements.text: Western civilisation is superior to other cultures and its achievements should not be apologised for.
missingStatements.rationale: The Proud Boys' founding creed is 'Western chauvinism', refusing to apologise for creating the modern world.

missingStatements.text: Feminism has harmed men and society more than it has helped.
missingStatements.rationale: Anti-feminism is a recurring theme: Yiannopoulos calls feminism man-hating and the Proud Boys oppose it.

missingStatements.text: Muslim immigration to Western countries should be stopped.
missingStatements.rationale: Yiannopoulos opposes Muslim immigration and calls fear of Islam rational, though the alt-lite as a whole is less uniform.

notes: Contested label: some named figures reject it, and critics (Media Matters, ADL) argue it blurs into the alt-right. Libertarian and economic-nationalist strands answer economics differently, so many answers are low confidence.
